summary: Diagnosed root cause: Claude Code 2.1.49 with --output-format json outputs ALL data to stderr as a JSON array (e.g., [{"type":"system","session_id":"..."}, {"type":"result","session_id":"..."}]), NOT individual JSON objects per line. stdout is completely empty. The previous fix added stderr fallback but extractSessionIdFromStdout couldn't parse JSON arrays — it only handled line-by-line JSON objects and whole-string JSON objects. Fixed by refactoring extractSessionIdFromStdout to: (1) extract a findInObject helper, (2) when whole-string JSON parse yields an array, iterate through elements looking for session_id fields. Added a test using the real Claude Code output format (JSON array with init/assistant/result events). All 22 repo-chat tests pass, build clean, lint 0 warnings.
